title: HUD Coins counter stuck at 0/5 after collecting a coin
observed: After the dash picks up a coin, state reports coins=1 but the HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5'. The HUD lags the game state.
expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5' right after the coin is collected.

title: Restart level leaves the game paused instead of running
observed: Pressing pause then clicking Restart level resets the values (score 0, lives 3, time 300), but mode stays 'paused' and the pause menu stays open.
expected: Restart level puts the level back to its start and the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing', no pause menu).

title: Spike hit makes score jump to 65136 instead of dropping by 500
observed: Score was 100. A dash over spikes cost a life, and the score became 65136 (about 100 - 500 wrapped as an unsigned 16-bit value) rather than being floored at 0.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points with the score floored at 0, so the score should be 0 after this hit.

title: Score goes negative (-200) and wraps to 65236 after spikes
observed: Spike hits set the score to 65236 (a wrapped value of -300), and later it shows -200 in the HUD, which is negative.
expected: Score is never negative and the spikes penalty is floored at 0, so the score should stay at or above 0.

title: Key-collected toast covers the pause menu Resume button
observed: With the pause menu open, btn-resume reports top=false, meaning another element (the 'Key collected' toast) sits on top of it at its centre, so a click on Resume would not reach it.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable, so nothing (including toasts) may cover the Resume button.

title: HUD Coins counter stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin
observed: After the dash-right at tick 2 collects a coin, state shows coins=1 and the HUD reads 'Coins 0/5'. The HUD stays stale on that value in the pause frame too.
expected: Per section 8 the HUD always shows the current values, so after collecting one coin it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

title: Spike hit drives score negative and wraps it to 65136
observed: At tick 4 the player (score 100) lands on spikes. Score jumps to 65136 (a wrapped value of 100 - 500), then goes to -300 on the next tick. HUD shows 'Score -300'.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score floors at 0 and is never negative. The score should read 0 after the hit, never 65136 or -300.

title: Level-complete Finish button covered by the time-bonus banner
observed: At tick 41 the 'Level complete!' dialog is open and btn-next (Finish) reports top=false while bonus-banner 'Time bonus +2590' is visible. The banner sits on top of the button, so a click there does not reach Finish.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable. Nothing may cover Finish, so a click on it should reach the button and advance to the victory dialog.
